description: This file defines the ModuleHandler class in Drupal, responsible for managing modules, including loading, reloading, dependency building, hook implementation management, and alter hook processing within a Drupal installation.

classes.name: Drupal\Core\Extension\ModuleHandler
classes.description: Class that manages modules in a Drupal installation, handling loading, dependencies, hook implementations, and alter hooks.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads a module by name if not already loaded.

methods.name: loadAll
methods.description: Loads all modules if not already loaded.

methods.name: reload
methods.description: Reloads all modules by resetting the loaded flag and loading again.

methods.name: isLoaded
methods.description: Checks if modules are loaded.

methods.name: getModuleList
methods.description: Returns the list of installed modules.

methods.name: getModule
methods.description: Retrieves a specific module by name, throws exception if not found.

methods.name: setModuleList
methods.description: Sets the module list and resets hook implementations.

methods.name: buildModuleDependencies
methods.description: Builds dependency graph for modules and sorts them.

methods.name: moduleExists
methods.description: Checks if a module exists.

methods.name: loadAllIncludes
methods.description: Deprecated method to load all include files for modules.

methods.name: loadInclude
methods.description: Loads a specific include file for a module and type.

methods.name: resetImplementations
methods.description: Resets hook implementation caches.

methods.name: hasImplementations
methods.description: Checks if a hook has implementations, optionally for specific modules.

methods.name: invokeAllWith
methods.description: Invokes a callback for all implementations of a hook.

methods.name: invoke
methods.description: Invokes a hook implementation for a module, or falls back to legacy function.

methods.name: legacyInvoke
methods.description: Calls legacy hook function if exists.

methods.name: invokeAll
methods.description: Invokes all implementations of a hook and merges results.

methods.name: invokeDeprecated
methods.description: Invokes a hook and triggers deprecation warning.

methods.name: invokeAllDeprecated
methods.description: Invokes all hooks and triggers deprecation warning.

methods.name: triggerDeprecationError
methods.description: Triggers deprecation warning for hooks.

methods.name: alter
methods.description: Performs alter hook processing, calling registered listeners.

methods.name: getCombinedListeners
methods.description: Builds combined list of alter hook listeners, handling duplicates and ordering.

methods.name: triggerErrorForDuplicateAlterHookListener
methods.description: Logs warning or notice for duplicate alter hook listeners.

methods.name: getHookOrderingRules
methods.description: Retrieves ordering rules for a hook.

methods.name: reOrderModulesForAlter
methods.description: Reorders modules for alter hooks based on hook_module_implements.

methods.name: getModuleDirectories
methods.description: Returns directories of all modules.

methods.name: getHookImplementationList
methods.description: Retrieves or builds the hook implementation list for a specific hook.
